articles.title: Markel Insurance appoints James Shankland as Head of Ocean Cargo, U.S.
articles.mainIdea: Markel Insurance appoints James Shankland as Head of Ocean Cargo, U.S.
articles.summary: CNW Group: Markel Insurance appoints James Shankland as Head of Ocean Cargo, U.S.. Markel, the insurance operations within Markel Group Inc. (NYSE: MKL), announced today the appointment of James Shankland as Head of Ocean Cargo, U.S. In this role, Shankland will lead the growth of Markel's U.S. cargo portfolio. He will be responsible for underwriting strategy, portfolio management and broker engagement. He'll work closely with actuarial, claims, operations and distribution to support disciplined execution across the business. Related tickers mentioned: MKL.
